items.title: 3 US Cash Yield Stocks Retail Investors Are Watching After The Inflation Surprise
items.summary: Inflation is pressing higher up the supply chain, with PPI running at 6.5% and CPI surprising on the upside, while markets brace for another Fed hike. That mix can pressure some stocks and benefit others as short-term yields reset. This article examines how that environment relates to cash and short-duration yield strategies, and highlights 3 stocks from the screener that appear particularly sensitive to this latest inflation shock.
